description: Java source file defining a command handler class for creating provisioning entries within the Fineract accounting provisioning module. It implements a method to process commands by invoking a service to create provisioning entries, with relevant annotations for dependency injection, transaction management, and command type specification.

classes.name: CreateProvisioningEntriesRequestCommandHandler
classes.description: A command handler class annotated as a service that handles creation commands for provisioning entries. It implements the processCommand method to handle incoming JSON commands and delegate the creation process to the underlying provisioning entries write platform service.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Handles the incoming JsonCommand, invokes the provisioningEntriesWritePlatformService to create provisioning entries, and returns the processing result.
